body.name: Neural target extrema and representation residual
body.construction: Set \(\mathcal F_{n,\mathrm N}=\{M\in M_{\mathrm N}:p_M\in C_n\}\), \(\ell_{n,\mathrm N}=\inf_{M\in\mathcal F_{n,\mathrm N}}Q(M)\), and \(u_{n,\mathrm N}=\sup_{M\in\mathcal F_{n,\mathrm N}}Q(M)\). The residual gap is \(\Gamma_n=(\ell_{n,\mathrm N}-\ell_{n,\mathrm{cert}})+(u_{n,\mathrm{cert}}-u_{n,\mathrm N})\).
